    Product Description

    This power bank protective case is designed to fit all power banks with dimensions equal to or smaller than 5.78*2.75*1.18 inches (147*70*30 mm), featuring a soft inner lining that offers full protection against scratches and impacts to keep your portable charger safe at all times. Specifically compatible with OHOVIV 50000mAh (N10), Charmast Slim 10000mAh (W1148), Citicr 10000mAh (AC-02D), YILANS 50000mAh, VRURC 10000mAh (T1116), FOCHEW 13800mAh, and VEEKTOMX 10000mAh (VT101) portable chargers, it also works perfectly with most slim, fast-charging power banks, making it a versatile choice for different models. Crafted with premium hard EVA material, this travel case boasts waterproof and scratch-resistant performance, effectively shielding your power bank from daily wear and tear. Please note that the zipper is not fully waterproof, so do not submerge the case in water for extended periods to avoid damage. In case of accidental drops, the durable EVA shell can absorb shocks efficiently, preventing damage to your device and prolonging its service life. For added convenience, the case is equipped with an internal mesh pocket specially designed to store charging cables, adapters, and other small accessories, keeping all your items organized and easy to carry. It also features soft rubber zipper pulls that ensure smooth and easy opening and closing, allowing you to access your power bank quickly whenever you need it.
